text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And so, that's pretty much it～……
I submitted my application to transfer to
Team <Ascella>!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait,
isn't that reaction super weird～～～?!
Hey! It's not like that at all!
I thought really hard about this,
you know?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Did you really though……?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Really,
really～～～! Thor-ough-ly! I watched her race,
we had a talk,
and then I knew I just had to run with
Ku-chan-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right,
senpai♡?
You even made me that handcrafted tiara and
gave it to me, didn't you～♡?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Pandora-san……——Wait, hold on! Um,
why are you calling me 『Senpai』?
I'm pretty sure we're in the exact same year,
right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, yeah, but…… who cares! Details,
details♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Are they really just details……?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……It appears this conversation has completely
derailed.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, yeah. What's up?

Transferring teams has a profound impact on
an Umamusume's future.
It is a matter of utmost gravity.
Allow me to confirm your resolve once
more.
choice_data_list: Can you do your best in Team <Asce...
Can you do your best in Team <Asce...

choice_data_list: Can you do your best in Team <Asce...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got!
It's gonna be awesome, guaranteed.
That's why——
please let me join Team <Ascella>!

……Right, I see. I understand how you feel.
In that case——
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it, Pandora
I'm looking forward to it, Pandora

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I see. I get how you feel.
In that case——
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it, Pandora
I'm looking forward to it, Pandora

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ! Woohoo~~~☆ Yay yay yaaay————♡!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm countin' on ya, Trainer☆!

And so, after quite a whirlwind,
Fusaichi Pandora joined Team <Ascella>.

A few days swiftly passed since training
began——
Mmmmmm~~~~....

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I knew you would still be here.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You should at least turn on the lights.

King... wait,
is it really that late already?
I totally lost track of time...

King... wait,
is it really that late already?
I totally lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, just as I thought.
...You were brooding over Pandora-san,
correct?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Figured as much.
...I have watched her over these past few days,
but——

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Frankly speaking,
that girl is quite a handful!

(Her previous trainer warned me,
but her raw talent is undeniable.
Even her teammates hold her in high
regard.)

(Her previous trainer warned me,
but her raw talent is undeniable.
Even her teammates hold her in high
regard.)

(She isn't unmotivated or slacking off...
Rather,
she always looks cheerful and full of
energy.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew, phew! Here I gooooo————!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Whoaah?!

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Incredible acceleration...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Goal♡ Whaddya think? How's my time?

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~...
You smashed the target time so easily~.
And that target was set super high,
too. Amazing~...

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Pandora,
that's insane...!
I've been struggling to hit that time for
three whole days,
and you beat it in just one...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Really? Super-duper really~?
Guess I truly am a genius!
I knew it~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, since target's cleared,
I'm calling it a day!
Good work today, everyone~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well,
she certainly tries hard in her own way.
...However, she lacks true seriousness.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She has likely overcome every obstacle on
raw talent alone...
She has never had to be truly desperate or
committed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yet the racing world does not permit such
complacency for long.
——Her results in the Oka Sho were quite
disastrous, were they not?

Yeah.
That's why I want her to redeem herself at
the Oaks.
...I want her to chase her dream with true
resolve.

Yeah.
That's why I want her to redeem herself at
the Oaks.
...I want her to chase her dream with true
resolve.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
...Then you must keep racking your brain,
just as always.
...Kiiiiiii~~...ng-...saaaaaa...n——!

Hm? ...Hear that?
That voice... and heavy footsteps...

Hm? ...Hear that?
That voice... and heavy footsteps...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...That voice, do not tell me——
KING-SAAAA-N!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eek?!
I'm sooooo very sorrrryyyy———!

The door, wall,
and everything that got smashed!
I promise to fix everything, so please...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good grief,
you never know your own strength...
What brings you here this late at night?
——Kawakami Princess-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And look at you... covered head to toe in dirt.
...Have you been training this entire
time?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gah! F-Forgive me for being such an unrefined,
dusty Princess! But I simply had to——King-san,
I had to report to you at once!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
From the very moment I laid eyes on you,
you were nobler and stronger than anyone else,
shining with first-rate brilliance——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You instilled an unbreakable dream within
my heart! So I had to tell you,
my admired King-san,
as soon as possible——!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san!
I could not make it in time for the Oka Sho...
but I qualified for the Oaks!

(! ...In Pandora's next race, the Oaks,
Kawakami Princess is running too...?)

(! ...In Pandora's next race, the Oaks,
Kawakami Princess is running too...?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san! Since my debut,
I have maintained an undefeated streak.
——My admiration for you gave me the strength
to push through!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to be a mere copy of someone
else.
For staying true to oneself is the foundation
of a true Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even on a different team,
taking a different path!
I will carry the nobility and strength you
taught me——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And become the greatest Princess in the
world~~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Keep running forward like that.
On your own path, upon your own two feet.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...She arrived like a hurricane and vanished
just as fast. Honestly,
what was that about?

Haha,
caught me off guard. ...Still...
admiration really is quite powerful,
isn't it?

Haha,
caught me off guard. ...Still...
admiration really is quite powerful,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want me to be Pandora-san's
mentor...?

choice_data_list: And more importantly, she admires you
And more importantly, she admires you
And more importantly, she admires you
And more importantly, she admires you

text_block_list.text:
Naturally,
prioritize your own goal for the Victoria Mile.
Even so——

Naturally,
prioritize your own goal for the Victoria Mile.
Even so——

Guiding someone else could help you reflect
on everything you've experienced so far.

Guiding someone else could help you reflect
on everything you've experienced so far.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
By teaching Pandora-san,
I can solidify my own understanding too,
right? I see...!

What do you think, Kraft?
If you ever feel lost,
I'll be right there to support you.

What do you think, Kraft?
If you ever feel lost,
I'll be right there to support you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Understood! I will do it. No,
I want to do it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Truth is,
I have been wanting to have a real
heart-to-heart with Pandora-san anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
As Pandora-san's mentor,
I'll give it everything I've got!
